findings.finding: Online dance classes can be successfully co-produced using evidence synthesis, expert advice, and stakeholder recommendations.
findings.quote: co-design of online classes, based on a research evidence synthesis, expert advice, and stakeholder recommendations

findings.finding: Dance teachers reported enhanced self-efficacy for teaching after attending study-specific training days.
findings.quote: Teachers reported improved self-efficacy for teaching dance to children with motor impairment after attending the training day.

findings.finding: Professional dance teachers experience high physical and mental workloads during their units.
findings.quote: The majority of dance teachers estimated their level of physical and mental workload to be almost as high as that of their students

principle: Training dance teachers and equipping them with specific study-based instruction manuals and co-designed online classes improves feasibility, delivery, and their teaching self-efficacy.
for_the_teacher: Participate in specialized training programs and review structured instruction manuals to boost your instructional self-efficacy.
